bosses.name: Yosuke's Shadow
bosses.party: Izanagi
bosses.strategy:
This is the first "boss fight" of the game. It's pretty simple. Spam
Izanagi's zio on him, and when he guards, you guard. If he uses Power
Charge, use zio first and take your extra turn using Guard. If your
health ever gets below half, make sure to use a medicine. (You have 5. Feel
free to use them!)...

bosses.name: Chie's Shadow
bosses.party: Izanagi
bosses.strategy:
Easy fight, just be careful. Have Yosuke cast Garu on her, and she'll
be knocked down. She'll put up a Green Wall soon after, so just use
your physical attacks. Whenever the game says that she gazes at Yosuke,
have him guard for that turn. If you don't, she'll use a strong attack
called Bottomless Envy (or mazio. I'm not quite sure, but I do know it
knocks him down) that leaves Dizzy, and gives her another turn. The fight
should be over after a little while. Use a medicine if you have to....

bosses.name: Avenger Knight
bosses.party: Izanagi, Pixie, Slime with Resist Physical
bosses.strategy:
This is actually a pretty hard fight. In fact, after those bosses before, the
next few bosses in the game are actually some of the hardest fights in the
game. I recommend using a Goho-M on the 5th floor so you're all charged up when
you fight him. You may even want to do a little bit of grinding before this
fight. Now... On to the actual fight. He uses regular physical attacks as well
as other single-target physical attacks, including poison skewer that may
inflict poison. I wouldn't even bother...

bosses.name: Yukiko's Shadow
bosses.party: If you're at a high enough level, use Jack Frost. Valkyrie if
bosses.strategy:
she knows Mabufu. Senri when the prince goes down.

This is probably the hardest fight you've done yet. She has a stong
area attack that takes away over half of your character's hp, and she
also summons a minion to aid her in battle. Have Chie cast Mabufu every
round, and this will hit the Charming Prince's weakness as well as
damage the real boss. Keep pressure on the minion until he falls down,
and then focus on Shadow Yukiko. Yukiko's Shadow will cast White Wall
on the Charming Prince, taking...

bosses.name: Contrarian King
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Daring Gigas
bosses.party: Anything that can resist Physical attacks.
bosses.strategy:
This boss hits hard, but it's not a hard fight. He is a lot like the
avenger knight, but a bit easier. He'll waste three turns buffing up,
and then he'll start attacking. He doesn't have any special attacks,
just the single-hit, regular attack. It will probably take away over
half of a character's hp. When he uses Power Charge, make your
characters guard. Pretty much, just heal whoever gets attacked, and
then have everyone use their strongest attacks on him....

bosses.name: Shadow Kanji
bosses.party: Any personas with strong attacks and area attacks. One that
bosses.strategy:
has resist physical. A persona with Support Skills. [Preferably
Tarunda]

This is probably the hardest fight yet. Not only does he have strong
area attacks, but he also has two minions, that are tough to take down
themselves. His main attack that will wipe you out is swift strike.
It's a physical area attack, that can hit up to three times. If it hits
three times, it's most likely game over for you.

First of all, start by killing Nice Guy. If possible, use physical area
attacks to bring him dow...

bosses.name: Intolerant Officer
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Amorous Snake
bosses.party: Anything with Agilao. Hua Po is good.
bosses.strategy:
This is an easy fight. Exploit his weakness, and just keep using all
out attacks. He uses Stagnant Air at the beginning of the battle, and
will then use Virus Wave sometime after. Heal the poison and keep
going. He can also use Mind Slice which also causes confusion, so be
ready for that. Just make sure everyone's hp is kept above 50% and the
battle will soon be over.

Galactic Punt works in this battle....

bosses.name: Rise's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything that can deal high damage.
bosses.strategy:
This isn't the "real" boss of this dungeon. The battle will end once
you take away a little more than half of her hp, once she starts using
Supreme Insight, just guard. Nothing you can really do, then.

For any difficulties in this fight, just make sure you keep everyone's
hp high, and just unleash your strongest attacks on her, just so you
don't waste time. (Your hp & sp will be restored at the end of battle,
preparing you for the real boss fight.)

Her attack arsenal is just low-level magic sp...

bosses.name: Shadow Teddie
bosses.party: Anything that's immune to ice. Ganga and Unicorn are good;
bosses.strategy:
Especially Ganga. If you have a high priestess social link, fuse Ganga and
hopefully she'll level up enough to learn Mediarama.

Not only is this a long fight, but it can get pretty troublesome if you
don't figure out his pattern. His favorite thing to do is use Mind
Charge, and then cast Mabufula. He'll also cast Marakunda, and then use
Heat Wave. If you try using buffs, there's a chance that he might use
Dekaja, so don't waste your time. Chances are, you'll have Yukiko in
your party as a heale...

bosses.name: Momentary Child
bosses.party: Ganga because of Bufula and Mediarama.
bosses.strategy:
This isn't a hard fight. He uses Herculean Strike, and it's pretty
strong. It will take over half of your party's hp away, so heal with
Media or Mediarama.

All you really have to do in this fight is cast Bufula repetitively,
and use Mediarama when hp is low. The boss is weak to ice, so hopefully
you're using Teddie, or even Chie.. Either way, have the MC and Teddie (or
Chie) use ice skills
while the other party members heal and use physical attacks. If your hp
is so low that you need extra heal...

bosses.name: Killing Hand
bosses.party: Personas with Magaru/Magarula/Garula.
bosses.strategy:
Thsi is an easy fight. It can be dragged on for a long time, though.
The killing Hand will summon an Almighty Hand to aid it in battle. The
almighty hand is weak against wind, so use wind attacks. If you have
Magarula, use that instead of Garula, sicne it deals extra damage to
the boss. Hit him with it two times and he'll become dizzy. Try to
focus your efforts on the Almighty Hand, and completely focus your
attacks on the killing hand when he's alone. He might summon another
one before the end ...

bosses.name: Mitsuo's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything with good agility. Black Frost is also helpful for
bosses.strategy:
dealing high damage with Agidyne. Dis is an alternatica to Black Frost.

This is an interesting, and tricky fight. It's also pretty fun if you
know how to handle it. I personally never had any problems with him, but he's
the one boss I always see people complaining about.

Once the battle starts, you'll be fighting an 8-bit "hero" version of
Mitsuo. This isn't the actual fight. It's an "outer shell" of him. It
has 1400 hp, and once you defeat it, you'll be fighting the real thing.
Once you defea...

bosses.name: Escapist Soldier
bosses.party: Anything with high attack power and Mediarama. ALso, a
bosses.strategy:
persona that is resistant in some way to dark attacks.

This is an easy fight. He has stong attacks, but they can only target
one charcter at a time. Try to keep everyone's health at max, because
of his strong attacks. He has the Evil Smile and Ghastly Wail combo, so
make sure you get rid of fear on whoever has it. It's an easy fight, if
you aren't winning, then just grind some more. The Gaia sword you get
from defeating this battle is very useful for a long while in the game.

Also, if you have...

bosses.name: Dominating Machine
bosses.party: A Null Physical persona is extremely helpful in this fight.
bosses.strategy:
This boss spends his whole time using Power Charge and then Herculean
Strike. His pattern can easily kill you if you don't heal when it's
needed... And even then, it's possible for him to defeat you in one
hit. Simply make sure that you keep your health full and attack when it
is. When his health gets to 25%, he'll stand by for three truns, then
use self-destruct. I suggest you try to defeat him in two rounds, and
if you don't, then have everyone guard to take less damage from him.

Another very...

bosses.name: Naoto's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything with Dekaja, or -dyne spells and high magic power.
bosses.strategy:
Ganga is a good idea for Dekaja + Mediarama, but not a must, seeing as
skills can be passed down. Genbu, or anything with Masukukaja is
helpful, seeing as Shadow Naoto likes to use Ma-dyne spells.

This is a challenging fight; not hard. Shadow Naoto seems to be a boss
that can actually think. She is very strategic, so give her a taste of
her own medicine.

First things fist, be prepared with Dekaja. She uses Heat Riser quite
often, and leaving that on would be suicide. She usually only uses it
w...

bosses.name: Extreme Vessel
bosses.party: Personas with Garula and Garudyne are nice.
bosses.strategy:
This boss is weak against wind, so just blast him with your strongest
wind spells and use Yosuke if he's a high enough level. If he uses
Power Charge, he will use God's Hand shortly after. It will instantly
kill a character, so make sure to revive. When he uses Power Charge,
switch to a null physical persona if you have one. When he uses Mind
Charge, guard because he will use a hard-hitting Ma-Dyne spell of some
sort. If you don't want to guard, use Makarakarn on the MC and have
everyone else gu...

bosses.name: World Balance
bosses.party: Personas with Makarakarn and a lot of elemental resistances.
bosses.strategy:
This is a straightforward fight. He'll use Mind Charge followed up by a
single-target -dyne spell. His spells usually hit for 600+ damage a
pop, so it means instant death. Luckily, they're only single target!
Therefore, there's practically no way he can kill your party unless he
targets a weakness or you decide not to revive any KO'ed chracters. If
you have personas with Makarakarn, use Makarakarn on the MC. If you
don't, then go to one that can reflect attacks, and isn't weak to any.
You really...

bosses.name: Kunino-Sagiri
bosses.party: Personas that reflect ANY element are HIGHLY recommended, and
bosses.strategy:
make this battle much, much easier.

This is a long, interesting fight. It's made much, much easier if you
have a persona that can reflect an element, though. Why? Because this
battle has an interesting pattern. Once you take away about 25% of his
health, he'll use an attack called "Quad Converge." This skill makes it
so that he is strong against all elements, but takes 3x damage from a
single one. You'll know which element it is, because it's the elememt
that he uses on your party. Once you con...

bosses.name: Lost Okina
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Chaos Fuzz
bosses.party: Personas with area spells AND single-target spells are nice.
bosses.strategy:
This is an easy fight. The first one will summon another, and the
second one will also do so. The key to this battle is to kill them all
at the same time. Usually, he'll only summon three. If more than three
are on the field, than it's just bad luck. Use area attacks throughout
the battle, and don't kill anyone in the process. Get everyone's hp low
[to the point there's only a tenth of hp left] and use Ma-dyne or an
almighty spell.

These guys don't hit hard. There physical attacks take away abo...

bosses.name: Giant of Envy
bosses.party: Personas with strong Physical and Almighty attacks.
bosses.resistances: Fire (Resist), Ice (Resist), Elec (Absorb), Wind (Resist), Light (Null), Dark (Null)
bosses.strategy:
This fight isn't too hard, but he isn't exactly a pushover. He resists
all types of attacks except for Physical and Almighty, and uses
Megidolaon almost every turn. Not only are physical attacks the only
element he doesn't resist, but he also has High Counter, making your
Physical attacks more ineffective. Still, blast him away with your
physical attacks, hoping for some criticals. Megidolaon is better, disregarding
the fact that it
takes so much sp. His only other attack is Tentarafoo, and he u...

bosses.name: Adachi
bosses.party: Any persona that nullifies physical attacks makes this boss
bosses.strategy:
seem like a joke. A persona with a lot of elemental resistances is also
nice.

This fight is pretty easy. He has high defense, so it might last a
while, but other than that, it's not hard at all. He'll usually cast
Vorpal Blade and -dyne and Ma-dyne spells. He occasionally uses Evil
Smile, followed up with Gastly Wail. Because of this, make sure you're
ready with items or Amrita.

Just attack his with physical attacks, and heal when your hp gets down
about halfway. It's as easy as that....

bosses.name: Amenosagiri
bosses.party: Anything is fine, really. If possible, bring along a persona
bosses.strategy:
with Spell Master that also has -dyne spells. Make sure that you also
have a persona with Mediarahan if one of your party members doesn't. If
you have a Trumpeter with Debilitate, then by all means use him.

Whew, awesome music for an awesome fight with an awesome disco ball-eye-thing!
If you have Yosuke in your party, have him use Masukukaja as much as
possible, and renew it when it wears off. When it isn't worn-off, use
Brave Blade. If you're using Chie, use Power Charge + God's Hand, pretty m...

bosses.name: Neo Minotaur
bosses.party: Null Physical is a lifesaver in this battle. Bring along a
bosses.strategy:
persona with null physical and just hit auto Battle.

This is an easy fight, depending on how you approach it. If you aren't
immune to physical attacks, expect him to kill you in atleast three
turns. His rampage attack can cause some serious damage, and it's an
instant kill if hits three times. However, Rampage is his only attack.
If you have a persona with Null Physical, by all means use him. It'll
make you completely invulnerable. He can use regular hyscial attacks,
but... They're still physic...

bosses.name: Sleeping Table
bosses.party: Personas that are immune to fire and light. Bring Yoshitsune
bosses.strategy:
if you have him.

Not a hard fight. The Sleeping Table usually just uses Megidolaon, and
takes away about half of the party's hp with each use. Other than
Megidolaon, expect him to cast Mahamaon and use the Evil Smile + Gastly
Wail combo throughout the battle. Make sure you heal Fear if you get
hit by it, or else it's instant game-over. Last, he uses Maragidyne. It
won't do much damage, just as much as Megidolaon. Still, make sure to
keep your party healed throughout the battle. Use Mediarahan w...

bosses.name: Izanami
bosses.party: Bring along Trumpeter obecause of the Debilitate/Heat Riser
bosses.strategy:
combo. Norn is also nice, since you don't really need Heat Riser.

More awesome music time! This fight, overall, is pretty straightforward.
Izanami is strong, and
will often knock-off more than half of the whole party's hp with her
attacks. The fight is pretty easy, despite the amount of damage she
deals. As long as you keep up with Mediarahan every round, you should
be fine. When her hp gets around half, she'll start using Mind Charge
then Megidolaon very often. Make sure you guard, as it can w...

bosses.name: Izanami-no-Okami
bosses.party: Trumpeter for Heat Riser/Debilitate Combo. Any strong
bosses.strategy:
personas with no weaknesses is good, as well. Yoshitsune,
Kohryu/Ishtar.

This is the real Final Boss, and she's not holding anything back. She
has a wide variety of new attacks, and the package even includes double
turns. Her new moves are impressive, and this fight will be long enough
so that you get to see all of them.

First of all, let's review her new attacks. This isn't exactly a
special attack of hers, but she will rarely use Agneyastra, and it can
wipe out a character if it gets three h...

bosses.name: The Reaper
bosses.location: Randomly in Treasure chests on New Game Plus
bosses.party: Personas like Helel that block Hama and Mudo skills help
bosses.strategy:
tremendously. Oh, and Yoshitsune. Why? Cause he's awesome.

This isn't a hard fight, but it can last for quite a long time, due to
high hp AND defense. The best way to get past this is to use Rakunda on
him and Matarukaja on your party. If you don't mind spending the time
doing it, I suggest cast Masukukaja as well.

He spends most of his time using all sorts of break skills and
Mahamaon/Mamudoon skills. Once he breaks everyone's resistances, he'll
use a lot of Ma-dyne attacks. It's pretty annoy...

bosses.name: Priestess (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori
bosses.strategy: This is a time-limited fight on a runaway monorail. You have 30 minutes (plenty of time) to reach the front and defeat the boss. Priestess has no elemental weaknesses. Use Junpei's physical attacks and the protagonist's strong physical/elemental attacks. Have Yukari heal using Media. Watch out for summon mobs; defeat them quickly.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Slash/Strike boosting accessories or standard health boosters. Use a persona like Omoikane or Pixie for support, or Valkyrie/Apsaras for physical/magic output.

bosses.name: Empress & Emperor (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada
bosses.strategy: The bosses will swap their elemental resistances and weaknesses using Paradigm Shift. Empress is immune/repels magic but is weak to physical. Emperor is immune/repels physical but is weak to magic. Direct Junpei's physical attacks to Empress and Akihiko's electric magic/Protagonist's magic to Emperor. Keep tracking their status screen.
bosses.buildPrep: Bring a persona that has both single-target physical (like Valkyrie or Ara Mitama) and magic skills (like Jack Frost or Lilim).

bosses.name: Hierophant (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada
bosses.strategy: Avoid bringing Yukari if possible, or keep her guarding, as the boss uses Zionga/Mazionga which hits her wind weakness. The boss also casts Prophecy of Ruin (Fear). Use Patra or Dis-Fear immediately. Focus on physical damage and fire/ice/wind magic. Akihiko can use Tarunda to decrease the boss's attack power.
bosses.buildPrep: Fuse a persona that resists or nullifies Electricity, such as Take-Minakata or Shiisaa. Stock up on Dis-Fear items.

bosses.name: Lovers (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada
bosses.strategy: Lovers will cast Holy Arrow to Charm your party members. Charmed members might heal the boss or strike teammates. Keep Yukari on healing/support duty to cast Patra/Me Patra. Deal damage using physical skills like Assault Dive or Double Fangs. Keep the protagonist's HP topped off.
bosses.buildPrep: Purchase 10+ Dis-Charm items from the pharmacy in Paulownia Mall. Use personas with Null/Resist Charm if available.

bosses.name: Chariot & Hermit (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Mitsuru Kirijo, Aigis
bosses.strategy: They start fused as one entity. Once you deplete their combined HP, they split into two separate bosses (Chariot and Hermit). You must defeat both of them in the same turn; otherwise, they will execute a Fusion Raid to revive each other with half HP. Get both of their HP bars down to a slither, then use a multi-target or sequential turn to kill both.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip personas with multi-target spells like Mabufu or Maragi, and ensure Aigis has Matarukaja to buff team attack.

bosses.name: Justice & Strength (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada, Koromaru
bosses.strategy: Strength does massive physical damage and uses Power Charge, while Justice uses Light-based instant-death spells (Hama) and targets weaknesses. Focus on Strength first using your strongest physical skills or magic. Use Akihiko's Tarunda to lower Strength's physical damage. Keep your party's HP above 80%.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Homunculus items on all characters to survive Hama instant-death spells. Avoid using personas weak to Light or Dark.

bosses.name: Hanged Man (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Akihiko Sanada, Mitsuru Kirijo, Aigis
bosses.strategy: The boss floats in the air and cannot be targeted. He summons three Maya statues. You must destroy all three statues to drag the Hanged Man down to the ground. Once he is grounded, he takes normal damage. Unload your strongest physical and elemental attacks (Brave Blade, Agidyne). Heal immediately if he uses Megidola.
bosses.buildPrep: Bring a dedicated healer like Yukari. Fuse personas with high physical defenses like Chernobog or Thor.

bosses.name: Nyx Avatar (Final Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Mitsuru Kirijo, Akihiko Sanada, Aigis
bosses.strategy: This is a massive 14-phase battle representing the Arcana (Fool to Death). Each phase changes Nyx's weaknesses, resistances, and behavior. The final phase (Death) has 6000+ HP and casts Night Queen, which deals severe Almighty damage and randomly inflicts status conditions (Charm, Rage, Fear). Use Mediarahan and Amrita Soda/Patra immediately.
bosses.buildPrep: Level up to at least 75. Bring a dedicated healer (Yukari with Mediarahan) and a buffer/debuffer (Akihiko or Aigis). Fuse Messiah, Odin, or Helel.

bosses.name: Priestess (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori
bosses.strategy: This is a time-limited fight on a runaway monorail. You have 30 minutes (plenty of time) to reach the front and defeat the boss. Priestess has no elemental weaknesses. Use Junpei's physical attacks and the protagonist's strong physical/elemental attacks. Have Yukari heal using Media. Watch out for summon mobs; defeat them quickly.

bosses.strategy: Avoid bringing Yukari if possible, or keep her guarding, as the boss uses Zionga/Mazionga which hits her wind weakness. The boss also casts Prophecy of Ruin (Fear). Use Patra or Dis-Fear immediately. Focus on physical damage and fire/ice/wind magic. Akihiko can use Tarunda to decrease the boss's attack power.
bosses.buildPrep: Fuse a persona that resists or nullifies Electricity, such as Take-Minakata or Shiisaa. Stock up on Dis-Fear items.

bosses.name: Lovers (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada
bosses.strategy: Lovers will cast Holy Arrow to Charm your party members. Charmed members might heal the boss or strike teammates. Keep Yukari on healing/support duty to cast Patra/Me Patra. Deal damage using physical skills like Assault Dive or Double Fangs. Keep the protagonist's HP topped off.
bosses.buildPrep: Purchase 10+ Dis-Charm items from the pharmacy in Paulownia Mall. Use personas with Null/Resist Charm if available.

bosses.name: Chariot & Hermit (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Mitsuru Kirijo, Aigis
bosses.strategy: They start fused as one entity. Once you deplete their combined HP, they split into two separate bosses (Chariot and Hermit). You must defeat both of them in the same turn; otherwise, they will execute a Fusion Raid to revive each other with half HP. Get both of their HP bars down to a slither, then use a multi-target or sequential turn to kill both.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip personas with multi-target spells like Mabufu or Maragi, and ensure Aigis has Matarukaja to buff team attack.

bosses.name: Justice & Strength (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada, Koromaru
bosses.strategy: Strength does massive physical damage and uses Power Charge, while Justice uses Light-based instant-death spells (Hama) and targets weaknesses. Focus on Strength first using your strongest physical skills or magic. Use Akihiko's Tarunda to lower Strength's physical damage. Keep your party's HP above 80%.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Homunculus items on all characters to survive Hama instant-death spells. Avoid using personas weak to Light or Dark.

bosses.name: Hanged Man (Arcana Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Akihiko Sanada, Mitsuru Kirijo, Aigis
bosses.strategy: The boss floats in the air and cannot be targeted. He summons three Maya statues. You must destroy all three statues to drag the Hanged Man down to the ground. Once he is grounded, he takes normal damage. Unload your strongest physical and elemental attacks (Brave Blade, Agidyne). Heal immediately if he uses Megidola.
bosses.buildPrep: Bring a dedicated healer like Yukari. Fuse personas with high physical defenses like Chernobog or Thor.

bosses.name: Nyx Avatar (Final Boss)
bosses.party: Yukari Takeba, Mitsuru Kirijo, Akihiko Sanada, Aigis
bosses.strategy: This is a massive 14-phase battle representing the Arcana (Fool to Death). Each phase changes Nyx's weaknesses, resistances, and behavior. The final phase (Death) has 6000+ HP and casts Night Queen, which deals severe Almighty damage and randomly inflicts status conditions (Charm, Rage, Fear). Use Mediarahan and Amrita Soda/Patra immediately.
bosses.buildPrep: Level up to at least 75. Bring a dedicated healer (Yukari with Mediarahan) and a buffer/debuffer (Akihiko or Aigis). Fuse Messiah, Odin, or Helel.

bosses.name: Shadow Kamoshida (Asmodeus)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Morgana, Ann Takamaki
bosses.strategy: In the first phase, attack him directly. In the second phase, Kamoshida will summon cognitive assistants or target specific members. You will be prompted to send one party member on a stealth mission to steal Kamoshida's crown. While they are sneakily moving, you MUST attack Kamoshida every turn to draw his attention. Once the crown is stolen, his defense falls to zero.
bosses.buildPrep: Purchase a few Medicines and Takemedic-Alls from Takemi's clinic in Yongen-Jaya. Equip Ryuji with physical-boosting gear.

bosses.name: Shadow Madarame (Azazel)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Yusuke Kitagawa, Morgana
bosses.strategy: Madarame splits into four painting parts (Left Eye, Right Eye, Nose, Mouth). The eyes and nose absorb physical attacks, but are vulnerable to magic. The mouth absorbs magic, but is vulnerable to physical. Use Ryuji and Yusuke's physical attacks on the mouth, and magic spells (Agi, Bufu, Zio) on the eyes/nose. Once the paintings are down, Madarame's true form appears. Perform baton passes to wipe him out.
bosses.buildPrep: Fuse Shiisaa or Ame-no-Uzume. Ensure the protagonist has a variety of elemental spells (Fire, Ice, Elec, Wind).

bosses.name: Shadow Kaneshiro (Bael)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Makoto Niijima, Yusuke Kitagawa
bosses.strategy: First, fight Kaneshiro directly. He will then summon Piggytron. Piggytron has very high defense and uses rolling physical attacks. When Kaneshiro charges his 'Super VIP Form' roll, you must either guard with everyone or throw a high-value item (like a gold coin or jewelry) to distract him, canceling the attack. Once Piggytron is broken, Kaneshiro is easy to defeat.
bosses.buildPrep: Bring Makoto for Media (AoE healing) and Rakukaja (defense buff). Make sure you have at least one high-value treasure item in inventory.

bosses.name: Shadow Wakaba (Cognitive Wakaba)
bosses.party: Morgana, Yusuke Kitagawa, Makoto Niijima
bosses.strategy: Wakaba flies high above the arena, making her immune to physical/melee attacks. Spam magic spells (Garu, Frei, Bufu) to deal chip damage. Futaba will periodically assist and deploy a ballista. When the prompt appears, assign a party member to fire the ballista. This knocks Wakaba to the ground, where she takes double damage from physical attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip defensive gear that reduces Wind or Physical damage. Bring Wind/Physical warding items if possible.

bosses.name: Shadow Okumura (Mammon)
bosses.party: Morgana, Haru Okumura, Makoto Niijima
bosses.strategy: This is a 30-minute time limit battle. You must fight waves of corporate robots. Each wave must be defeated entirely within 2 turns; otherwise, the survivors flee and the wave resets. Wave 1 is weak to Fire/Wind. Wave 2 is weak to Ice/Psy. Wave 3 is weak to Elec/Nuke. Wave 4 is weak to Wind/Bless. Wave 5 (Tall Executive) is weak to Psy/Curse. Use single-target elemental items or spells to chain Baton Passes to Level 4 for massive damage.
bosses.buildPrep: Craft element-damage items (Psy Magatamas, Wind Magatamas) before the palace run. Bring Haru for Psy attacks, Morgana for Wind, and Makoto for Nuke.

bosses.name: Shadow Sae (Leviathan)
bosses.party: Makoto Niijima, Ryuji Sakamoto, Ann Takamaki
bosses.strategy: The battle starts with a Roulette game. You must not attack Sae or use healing spells, or she will drain your HP/SP as a penalty. Place your bets as directed. Once the cheat is exposed, send a party member to disable the glass-top cheating mechanism. In the second phase, Sae transforms and uses multi-elemental attacks. Debuff her with Tarunda.
bosses.buildPrep: Have a persona with Dekaja to remove Sae's Heat Riser. Bring characters with good magic defense.

bosses.name: Shadow Shido (Samael)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Ann Takamaki, Makoto Niijima
bosses.strategy: A multi-phase fight. Phase 1 (Beast of Sacrifice) repels magic, use physical. Phase 2 (Wings of Sacrifice) repels physical, use magic. Phase 3 (Tomb of Sacrifice) uses heavy elemental spells. The final phase is Shido himself. Shido casts Megidolaon and Tyrant's Fist. Buff your party's defense with Makoto's Marakukaja and debuff Shido with Tarunda or Debilitate.
bosses.buildPrep: Bring a persona that knows Megidolaon and Debilitate (like Trumpeter). Ensure all party members have Mediarahan or similar heals.

bosses.name: Yaldabaoth (God of Control)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Makoto Niijima, Ann Takamaki
bosses.strategy: Yaldabaoth will spawn four arms: Gun (reflects Wind/Bless), Bell (reflects Fire/Psy), Sword (reflects Phys/Slash), and Book (reflects Ice/Nuke). The arms inflict status conditions like Lust, Wrath, Gluttony, and Pride. You must defeat the arms quickly using AoE magic or strong physical skills (Hassou Tobi) before they coordinate an ultimate attack.
bosses.buildPrep: Max out all primary weapons/armor. Bring 5+ Soma or Balm of Life items. Fuse Yoshitsune, Satanael, or Kohryu.

bosses.name: Dr. Takuto Maruki & Azathoth
bosses.party: Goro Akechi, Sumire Yoshizawa, Makoto Niijima
bosses.resistances: Azathoth (Nullifies elements if tentacles are active)
bosses.strategy: You must attack and defeat the tentacles first to break Azathoth's shield. The tentacles have specific elemental weaknesses (Fire, Psy, etc.) which change. Once the tentacles are down, focus all damage on Azathoth (the main Persona). Maruki will periodically ban certain action types (e.g. healing, physical attacks, magic). Baton pass frequently to boost damage.
bosses.buildPrep: Ensure the Faith (Sumire) and Councillor (Maruki) confidants are maxed out. Bring high-end personas like Yoshitsune, Fafnir, or Raoul.

bosses.name: Shadow Kamoshida (Asmodeus)
bosses.party: Ryuji Sakamoto, Morgana, Ann Takamaki
bosses.strategy: In the first phase, attack him directly. In the second phase, Kamoshida will summon cognitive assistants or target specific members. You will be prompted to send one party member on a stealth mission to steal Kamoshida's crown. While they are sneakily moving, you MUST attack Kamoshida every turn to draw his attention. Once the crown is stolen, his defense falls to zero.
bosses.buildPrep: Purchase a few Medicines and Takemedic-Alls from Takemi's clinic in Yongen-Jaya. Equip Ryuji with physical-boosting gear.

Baton pass frequently to boost damage.
bosses.buildPrep: Ensure the Faith (Sumire) and Councillor (Maruki) confidants are maxed out. Bring high-end personas like Yoshitsune, Fafnir, or Raoul.

bosses.name: Yosuke's Shadow
bosses.party: Izanagi
bosses.strategy:
This is the first "boss fight" of the game. It's pretty simple. Spam
Izanagi's zio on him, and when he guards, you guard. If he uses Power
Charge, use zio first and take your extra turn using Guard. If your
health ever gets below half, make sure to use a medicine. (You have 5. Feel
free to use them!)...

bosses.name: Chie's Shadow
bosses.party: Izanagi
bosses.strategy:
Easy fight, just be careful. Have Yosuke cast Garu on her, and she'll
be knocked down. She'll put up a Green Wall soon after, so just use
your physical attacks. Whenever the game says that she gazes at Yosuke,
have him guard for that turn. If you don't, she'll use a strong attack
called Bottomless Envy (or mazio. I'm not quite sure, but I do know it
knocks him down) that leaves Dizzy, and gives her another turn. The fight
should be over after a little while. Use a medicine if you have to....

bosses.name: Avenger Knight
bosses.party: Izanagi, Pixie, Slime with Resist Physical
bosses.strategy:
This is actually a pretty hard fight. In fact, after those bosses before, the
next few bosses in the game are actually some of the hardest fights in the
game. I recommend using a Goho-M on the 5th floor so you're all charged up when
you fight him. You may even want to do a little bit of grinding before this
fight. Now... On to the actual fight. He uses regular physical attacks as well
as other single-target physical attacks, including poison skewer that may
inflict poison. I wouldn't even bother...

bosses.name: Yukiko's Shadow
bosses.party: If you're at a high enough level, use Jack Frost. Valkyrie if
bosses.strategy:
she knows Mabufu. Senri when the prince goes down.

This is probably the hardest fight you've done yet. She has a stong
area attack that takes away over half of your character's hp, and she
also summons a minion to aid her in battle. Have Chie cast Mabufu every
round, and this will hit the Charming Prince's weakness as well as
damage the real boss. Keep pressure on the minion until he falls down,
and then focus on Shadow Yukiko. Yukiko's Shadow will cast White Wall
on the Charming Prince, taking...

bosses.name: Contrarian King
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Daring Gigas
bosses.party: Anything that can resist Physical attacks.
bosses.strategy:
This boss hits hard, but it's not a hard fight. He is a lot like the
avenger knight, but a bit easier. He'll waste three turns buffing up,
and then he'll start attacking. He doesn't have any special attacks,
just the single-hit, regular attack. It will probably take away over
half of a character's hp. When he uses Power Charge, make your
characters guard. Pretty much, just heal whoever gets attacked, and
then have everyone use their strongest attacks on him....

bosses.name: Shadow Kanji
bosses.party: Any personas with strong attacks and area attacks. One that
bosses.strategy:
has resist physical. A persona with Support Skills. [Preferably
Tarunda]

This is probably the hardest fight yet. Not only does he have strong
area attacks, but he also has two minions, that are tough to take down
themselves. His main attack that will wipe you out is swift strike.
It's a physical area attack, that can hit up to three times. If it hits
three times, it's most likely game over for you.

First of all, start by killing Nice Guy. If possible, use physical area
attacks to bring him dow...

bosses.name: Intolerant Officer
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Amorous Snake
bosses.party: Anything with Agilao. Hua Po is good.
bosses.strategy:
This is an easy fight. Exploit his weakness, and just keep using all
out attacks. He uses Stagnant Air at the beginning of the battle, and
will then use Virus Wave sometime after. Heal the poison and keep
going. He can also use Mind Slice which also causes confusion, so be
ready for that. Just make sure everyone's hp is kept above 50% and the
battle will soon be over.

Galactic Punt works in this battle....

bosses.name: Rise's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything that can deal high damage.
bosses.strategy:
This isn't the "real" boss of this dungeon. The battle will end once
you take away a little more than half of her hp, once she starts using
Supreme Insight, just guard. Nothing you can really do, then.

For any difficulties in this fight, just make sure you keep everyone's
hp high, and just unleash your strongest attacks on her, just so you
don't waste time. (Your hp & sp will be restored at the end of battle,
preparing you for the real boss fight.)

Her attack arsenal is just low-level magic sp...

bosses.name: Shadow Teddie
bosses.party: Anything that's immune to ice. Ganga and Unicorn are good;
bosses.strategy:
Especially Ganga. If you have a high priestess social link, fuse Ganga and
hopefully she'll level up enough to learn Mediarama.

Not only is this a long fight, but it can get pretty troublesome if you
don't figure out his pattern. His favorite thing to do is use Mind
Charge, and then cast Mabufula. He'll also cast Marakunda, and then use
Heat Wave. If you try using buffs, there's a chance that he might use
Dekaja, so don't waste your time. Chances are, you'll have Yukiko in
your party as a heale...

bosses.name: Momentary Child
bosses.party: Ganga because of Bufula and Mediarama.
bosses.strategy:
This isn't a hard fight. He uses Herculean Strike, and it's pretty
strong. It will take over half of your party's hp away, so heal with
Media or Mediarama.

All you really have to do in this fight is cast Bufula repetitively,
and use Mediarama when hp is low. The boss is weak to ice, so hopefully
you're using Teddie, or even Chie.. Either way, have the MC and Teddie (or
Chie) use ice skills
while the other party members heal and use physical attacks. If your hp
is so low that you need extra heal...

bosses.name: Killing Hand
bosses.party: Personas with Magaru/Magarula/Garula.
bosses.strategy:
Thsi is an easy fight. It can be dragged on for a long time, though.
The killing Hand will summon an Almighty Hand to aid it in battle. The
almighty hand is weak against wind, so use wind attacks. If you have
Magarula, use that instead of Garula, sicne it deals extra damage to
the boss. Hit him with it two times and he'll become dizzy. Try to
focus your efforts on the Almighty Hand, and completely focus your
attacks on the killing hand when he's alone. He might summon another
one before the end ...

bosses.name: Mitsuo's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything with good agility. Black Frost is also helpful for
bosses.strategy:
dealing high damage with Agidyne. Dis is an alternatica to Black Frost.

This is an interesting, and tricky fight. It's also pretty fun if you
know how to handle it. I personally never had any problems with him, but he's
the one boss I always see people complaining about.

Once the battle starts, you'll be fighting an 8-bit "hero" version of
Mitsuo. This isn't the actual fight. It's an "outer shell" of him. It
has 1400 hp, and once you defeat it, you'll be fighting the real thing.
Once you defea...

bosses.name: Escapist Soldier
bosses.party: Anything with high attack power and Mediarama. ALso, a
bosses.strategy:
persona that is resistant in some way to dark attacks.

This is an easy fight. He has stong attacks, but they can only target
one charcter at a time. Try to keep everyone's health at max, because
of his strong attacks. He has the Evil Smile and Ghastly Wail combo, so
make sure you get rid of fear on whoever has it. It's an easy fight, if
you aren't winning, then just grind some more. The Gaia sword you get
from defeating this battle is very useful for a long while in the game.

Also, if you have...

bosses.name: Dominating Machine
bosses.party: A Null Physical persona is extremely helpful in this fight.
bosses.strategy:
This boss spends his whole time using Power Charge and then Herculean
Strike. His pattern can easily kill you if you don't heal when it's
needed... And even then, it's possible for him to defeat you in one
hit. Simply make sure that you keep your health full and attack when it
is. When his health gets to 25%, he'll stand by for three truns, then
use self-destruct. I suggest you try to defeat him in two rounds, and
if you don't, then have everyone guard to take less damage from him.

Another very...

bosses.name: Naoto's Shadow
bosses.party: Anything with Dekaja, or -dyne spells and high magic power.
bosses.strategy:
Ganga is a good idea for Dekaja + Mediarama, but not a must, seeing as
skills can be passed down. Genbu, or anything with Masukukaja is
helpful, seeing as Shadow Naoto likes to use Ma-dyne spells.

This is a challenging fight; not hard. Shadow Naoto seems to be a boss
that can actually think. She is very strategic, so give her a taste of
her own medicine.

First things fist, be prepared with Dekaja. She uses Heat Riser quite
often, and leaving that on would be suicide. She usually only uses it
w...

bosses.name: Extreme Vessel
bosses.party: Personas with Garula and Garudyne are nice.
bosses.strategy:
This boss is weak against wind, so just blast him with your strongest
wind spells and use Yosuke if he's a high enough level. If he uses
Power Charge, he will use God's Hand shortly after. It will instantly
kill a character, so make sure to revive. When he uses Power Charge,
switch to a null physical persona if you have one. When he uses Mind
Charge, guard because he will use a hard-hitting Ma-Dyne spell of some
sort. If you don't want to guard, use Makarakarn on the MC and have
everyone else gu...

bosses.name: World Balance
bosses.party: Personas with Makarakarn and a lot of elemental resistances.
bosses.strategy:
This is a straightforward fight. He'll use Mind Charge followed up by a
single-target -dyne spell. His spells usually hit for 600+ damage a
pop, so it means instant death. Luckily, they're only single target!
Therefore, there's practically no way he can kill your party unless he
targets a weakness or you decide not to revive any KO'ed chracters. If
you have personas with Makarakarn, use Makarakarn on the MC. If you
don't, then go to one that can reflect attacks, and isn't weak to any.
You really...

bosses.name: Kunino-Sagiri
bosses.party: Personas that reflect ANY element are HIGHLY recommended, and
bosses.strategy:
make this battle much, much easier.

This is a long, interesting fight. It's made much, much easier if you
have a persona that can reflect an element, though. Why? Because this
battle has an interesting pattern. Once you take away about 25% of his
health, he'll use an attack called "Quad Converge." This skill makes it
so that he is strong against all elements, but takes 3x damage from a
single one. You'll know which element it is, because it's the elememt
that he uses on your party. Once you con...

bosses.name: Lost Okina
bosses.party: None
bosses.strategy: No strategy provided....

bosses.name: Chaos Fuzz
bosses.party: Personas with area spells AND single-target spells are nice.
bosses.strategy:
This is an easy fight. The first one will summon another, and the
second one will also do so. The key to this battle is to kill them all
at the same time. Usually, he'll only summon three. If more than three
are on the field, than it's just bad luck. Use area attacks throughout
the battle, and don't kill anyone in the process. Get everyone's hp low
[to the point there's only a tenth of hp left] and use Ma-dyne or an
almighty spell.

These guys don't hit hard. There physical attacks take away abo...

bosses.name: Giant of Envy
bosses.party: Personas with strong Physical and Almighty attacks.
bosses.strategy:
This fight isn't too hard, but he isn't exactly a pushover. He resists
all types of attacks except for Physical and Almighty, and uses
Megidolaon almost every turn. Not only are physical attacks the only
element he doesn't resist, but he also has High Counter, making your
Physical attacks more ineffective. Still, blast him away with your
physical attacks, hoping for some criticals. Megidolaon is better, disregarding
the fact that it
takes so much sp. His only other attack is Tentarafoo, and he u...

bosses.name: Adachi
bosses.party: Any persona that nullifies physical attacks makes this boss
bosses.strategy:
seem like a joke. A persona with a lot of elemental resistances is also
nice.

This fight is pretty easy. He has high defense, so it might last a
while, but other than that, it's not hard at all. He'll usually cast
Vorpal Blade and -dyne and Ma-dyne spells. He occasionally uses Evil
Smile, followed up with Gastly Wail. Because of this, make sure you're
ready with items or Amrita.

doing it, I suggest cast Masukukaja as well.
